R1.description: From a captured candidate the bridge builds the Codex tester's folder: a read-only clone equal to the candidate's manifest, a scratch bare origin, the output folder and writable-location targets inside the scratch area, the Controller-only check directory and item record outside it, the stand-ins on the `PATH`, and the controls of `codex_sandbox.build`; a mismatch or any failure refuses before anything runs and removes the folder (#222)

R2.description: The clone sequence and the binding comparison are one implementation shared with the Claude tester through behaviour-preserving extractions, so the Claude tester's behaviour and tests are unchanged and no second set of checkout rules exists (#222)

R3.description: After a run the binding check reports any difference between the clone and the candidate in the shared words, and the scratch origin and output folder are not part of it (#222)

R4.description: The tester's prompt for Codex is the one shared text with the Codex sandbox's own limits, checked against the profile; the Claude prompt is byte-identical when no limits are given (#222)

R5.description: Nothing launches Codex, no role is declared, and the launch paths, the reviewer, `build_verification`, settings, options, exit codes and gates are unchanged; the guide and roadmap say so (#222)
